title: ROC AUC with Ties
signature: def roc_auc(y_true: np.ndarray, scores: np.ndarray) -> float
hints: AUC is the probability that a random positive scores higher than a random negative, counting a tie as half.
Rank all scores together. The sum of the positives' ranks, minus n_pos(n_pos + 1)/2, counts the (positive, negative) pairs the positives win. That is the Mann-Whitney U statistic.
Tied scores must share the average of the ranks they span. Sort, find the runs of equal values, and give each run the mean of its positions.
